$comment: Non-secret settings of the platform conformance harness (tests/README.md, section Settings and secrets). Values in <angle brackets> are placeholders that the provisioning step fills in; a live test that needs one stays Inconclusive until then. Secrets never go here: OCTOPUS_API_KEY, CODEFRESH_API_KEY, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET and GITHUB_TOKEN come only from environment variables, and AZURE_TENANT_ID and AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID override the values below. PLATFORM_SETTINGS_FILE points the harness at another copy.

build.$comment: Build tier (ADR-IR34): the shared registry and the Codefresh Runner cluster aks-platform-build, outside both app tiers. Same subscription as the app tiers.

nonprod.$comment: Cluster aks-platform-nonprod: environments tdd and uat, and previews.

prod.$comment: Cluster aks-platform-prod: environment prod. Destructive tests never target this tier.

TimeLimits.$comment: Runbook env-wake allows 20 minutes (Wake.TimeoutMinutes); Argo CD verification allows 900 seconds (Argo.VerificationTimeoutSeconds).
